sloka: स त्वम् भ्राता असि मे राजन् ब्रूहि माम् यद् यद् इच्चसि ।ज्येष्ठो मान्यः पितृसमो न च धर्मपथे स्थितः ॥६-१६-१९॥।।
transliteration: sa tvam bhrātā asi me rājan brūhi mām yad yad iccasi ।jyeṣṭho mānyaḥ pitṛsamo na ca dharmapathe sthitaḥ ॥6-16-19॥।।

translations.english: "O King You, being my elder brother, you may tell me What you wish. You are equal to father being elder brother and are to be honoured. But you have not followed the righteous path. The words you spoke are not pardonable."
